entry.title: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
entry.summary: Security researchers found a vulnerability in the APIs of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google that lets them extract encrypted reasoning traces and move them between models. A scan of public sessions turned up dozens of passwords and API keys. The traces also show that the reasoning summaries users see often hide what the models are actually doing. entry.title: TGRHuman: Text-Guided Realistic 3D Human Generation via Diffusion Renderer
entry.summary: Realistic 3D human generation plays a crucial role in many graphics applications.
